changes_made.explanation: Simplified model names to canonical forms, removed redundant descriptive phrases that refer to the same underlying GPT-2 models. Added 'Data Augmentation' as a task since the paper focuses on generating synthetic data for parser improvement. Added 'semantic parses' as outputs since the 2-stage method generates parse trees as intermediate outputs.
Normalized capitalization for consistency. All metrics are correctly extracted and relevant to NLG evaluation.
Correctly determined no LLM-as-judge evaluation. Removed placeholder 'None' values as they are not needed.

Correctly determined no human evaluation. Removed placeholder 'None' values as they are not needed. The paper acknowledges that expert annotation would be needed in practice but didn't conduct human eval in their experiments.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on privacy-preserving generation of synthetic utterances for semantic parsing in task-oriented dialogue systems. The extraction quality was good overall, with minor normalization needed. Main contributions: 1-stage vs 2-stage DP generation methods evaluated primarily with automatic metrics (MAUVE, overlap metrics) on semantic parsing datasets.
